title: Public Records Request
key_finding: The City routes police public-records requests through the Ocoee Police Department, names a records section at 646 Ocoee Commerce Parkway, and lists Ocoee police records staff and contact information.

title: Accreditation
key_finding: The City's police accreditation page says the Ocoee Police Department is accredited, lists reaccreditation on October 23, 2025, and presents the department as a current city police organization with multiple operational subpages.

title: County and Municipal Offense Report 2020A
key_finding: FDLE's official 2020 county-and-municipal offense report lists Ocoee Police Department as an Orange County municipal row with population 49,781 and total index crime 1,263.

title: County and Municipal Offense Report 2021A
key_finding: FDLE's official 2021 county-and-municipal offense report retains Ocoee Police Department as a named municipal row with population 48,202 but shows dashes in every offense field.

title: FIBRS Offense Detail 2021-2025 Q3 workbook
key_finding: Inspection of the official FDLE workbook found no Ocoee row in the 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, or 2025 Q3 offense sheets.

title: FBI Crime Data Explorer agency roster endpoint for Florida
key_finding: A live query on March 24, 2026 returned FL0480300 Ocoee Police Department as a City agency with is_nibrs false and no nibrs_start_date.

title: agency_rosters_2024.csv
key_finding: The cached official FBI CDE 2024 roster also lists FL0480300 Ocoee Police Department in Orange County with is_nibrs false.

title: fdle_fibrs_2024_offense_period_extract.csv
key_finding: The normalized extract built from FDLE's official 2024 FIBRS workbook contains no Ocoee agency row.

title: agency_to_jurisdiction_crosswalk.csv
key_finding: The live crosswalk routes FL0480300 exclusively to 12:municipal:place:1251075 Ocoee city with relationship_type exclusive and weight 1.0.

title: agency_master.parquet
key_finding: FL0480300 is classified as a local police department with both SRS and NIBRS presence flags through 2024, which conflicts with the official FBI roster returning is_nibrs false.

title: agency_year_observations.parquet
key_finding: Repo observations for FL0480300 match FDLE's 2020 municipal row exactly, then collapse to zero-valued annual SRS placeholders from 2021 through 2024 with no NIBRS rows.

title: jurisdiction_controls_2024.parquet
key_finding: All seven 2024 Ocoee offense controls are fully fill-backed because preferred reported support is zero and the row is treated as structurally missing or unreliable.

title: municipal_target_review_queue.csv
key_finding: Ocoee is queued in high_impact_full_fill_place with suspect_reason full_fill_no_reported_support, six flagged offense rows, total_fill_count 1474.0, and zero reported support.
